graphEvents.label: How does a Figma frame flow become a flow model

label: Design-file reading is a separate verb family from FigJam writing: files, node tree, get/inspect and export screenshot|node|css|tailwind all act on the open design file.

The FigJam write surface has exactly six mutating verbs (sticky, shape, text, connect, move, update) and no image, frame, section, table, code-block or embed verb, so a Figma frame cannot be placed into a FigJam board through the documented surface.
No cross-file bridge from a design file to a FigJam board is documented anywhere in the skill; the two verb families never meet.
A frame flow is still enumerable with grounded evidence: node tree for hierarchy and names, inspect for specs, export screenshot plus sk-vision for pixels.
extract writes DESIGN.md and auto-splits into DESIGN-structure above roughly 50k tokens, so intake must pin one frame subtree rather than a whole file.
All surface claims remain documentation-grade because the CLI was not executed here; the skill records the docs-versus-source drift as a confirmed gap and requires --help verification.
